name: Swing Tags
summary: A price range filter whose two knobs carry swinging price tags over a live stock chart
about: A two-knob price filter for a clothing shop in rupees. Each knob carries a hanging price tag that leans as you drag and swings back when you let go, while the stock chart above lights up the bars inside your range and the count rolls to match. Press the button and the bars sink away as matching suits land in their place.
how: Drag either knob, press the rail to pull the nearest one, or focus a knob and use the arrow, Page and Home/End keys
Type an exact lowest or highest price in the Min and Max fields and press Enter
Tap a quick range such as Under 5k or Luxury 18k+ and both tags glide there
Press Show suits to see three matching suits land with the total, and Edit price range to go back
